name: Gelateria Lago di Garda
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gelateria Lago di Garda in Innsbruck!**

Indulge in authentic Italian gelato made with the finest ingredients from the breathtaking **Lago di Garda**. Our creamy, artisanal flavors—from classic **Stracciatella** to seasonal specialties—are crafted with love to bring a taste of Italy to the heart of the **Tirol**.

Whether you're strolling through **Innsbruck’s** charming streets or relaxing after a day of hiking in the **Alps**, our gelato is the perfect sweet escape. Visit us at **[address]** and let your taste buds travel to the shores of **Lago di Garda**!

*Buon gelato!* 🍦
